cloud.backup_desc: Encrypted backups with AES-256-GCM. Daily DB + weekly file backups, auto-pruned. Your key - we can't read it.
cloud.feature_accounting_desc: Push invoices and contacts to QuickBooks or Xero, with bank reconciliation. No double entry - your books stay current.
cloud.feature_ai_desc: Ask questions about your business in plain English. Inventory analysis, AR summaries, auto-draft purchase orders, invoice reconciliation.
cloud.feature_backup_desc: Your database is automatically backed up and encrypted before upload. If your machine dies, restore the encrypted backup to a replacement machine.
cloud.feature_payments_desc: Invoices get paid faster when they carry a Pay button. Online payments record and reconcile automatically.
cloud.feature_url_desc: Get a permanent address like yourname.celerp.com. Share it with your staff - they open a browser and log in with the permissions you set. No VPN, no port forwarding, no IT setup.
cloud.feature_website_desc: Sync orders, products, and customers from your Shopify and WooCommerce stores - automatically, on a schedule.
cloud.hero_desc1: Check stock from home. Let your staff log in from the shop floor, each with the permissions you set. Celerp keeps running on your machine and your data stays there - Web Access adds a secure URL (like yourname.celerp.com) you can reach from any browser.
cloud.hero_desc2: Your database stays on your machine. Web Access securely relays traffic between your browser and Celerp.
cloud.partner_managed_note: Your Celerp subscription is managed by your implementation partner.
cloud.plan_ai_desc: Everything in Connect, plus an assistant that knows your business.
cloud.trial_sub: A card is required, but nothing is charged for 14 days. Cancel during the trial and pay nothing - we'll email you before it ends.

labels.err_template_not_found: Celerp couldn't find this label template. It may have been deleted. Refresh the page.
labels.err_template_name_required: Enter a name for the label template.
labels.err_template_create: The label template wasn't created: {error}. Check the name and try again.
labels.err_template_create_unknown: The label template wasn't created. Try again; if it keeps happening, ask on GitHub Issues or Discussions.
company.err_permission_fixed: This permission always belongs to the company owner and can't be given to other roles.
company.err_permission_floor: This permission can't be given to roles below {role}. Choose {role} or a higher role.
company.err_location_invalid: That location isn't valid. Refresh the page and choose it again.
company.err_location_not_found: Celerp couldn't find this location. It may have been deleted. Refresh the page.
company.err_location_default: This is your default location, so it can't be deleted. Make another location the default first.
company.err_location_in_use: {count} item(s) are still at this location, so it can't be deleted. Move them to another location first.
company.err_role_above_own: You can't give someone a higher role than your own. Ask the company owner to do it.
company.err_user_already_member: This person already has access to this company. Change their role in the user list instead.
company.err_user_not_added: Celerp couldn't add this user. Nothing was saved. Try again; if it keeps happening, ask on GitHub Issues or Discussions.
company.err_user_not_found: Celerp couldn't find this user. They may have been removed. Refresh the page.
company.err_user_above_own: You can't change a user whose role is higher than yours. Ask the company owner to do it.
company.err_last_owner_demote: This is the only owner, so their role can't be lowered. Make another user an owner first.
company.err_last_owner_deactivate: This is the only owner, so they can't be deactivated. Make another user an owner first.
company.err_name_no_letters: This name has no letters or numbers. Enter a name with at least one letter or number.
company.err_category_exists: A category called {name} already exists. Choose a different name.
company.err_category_not_found: Celerp couldn't find the category {name}. It may have been deleted. Refresh the page.
company.err_category_in_use: {count} item(s) are in this category, so it can't be deleted. Move them to another category first.
company.err_unit_name: The unit name {name} can only use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (_). Remove spaces and capitals.
company.err_unit_decimals: Unit {name}: decimal places must be a number from 0 to 6.
company.err_unit_duplicate: There are two units called {name}. Rename or remove one of them.
company.err_module_not_found: Celerp couldn't find this module. It may already have been removed. Refresh the page.
company.err_module_default: This module is part of Celerp, so it can't be deleted. You can disable it instead.
company.err_purge_dependency: This module's data couldn't be removed because another module still uses it. Nothing was deleted. Remove or disable the other module first, or ask its developer.
company.err_purge_failed: Something went wrong removing this module's data. Nothing was removed. Try again; if it keeps happening, ask on GitHub Issues or Discussions.
company.err_checkout_failed: Celerp couldn't start the purchase. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, ask on GitHub Issues or Discussions.
company.err_checkout_bad_reply: Celerp's online service sent an answer Celerp couldn't read, so the purchase didn't start. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, ask on GitHub Issues or Discussions.
company.err_download_damaged: This download is damaged. Download it again.
company.err_module_unavailable: This module isn't available to download right now. Try again later, or check the Marketplace for an updated version.
company.err_download_refused: Celerp's online service didn't allow this download. Check that your plan includes this module in Web Access.
company.err_download_too_large: This module download is larger than 50 MB, so it can't be installed. If you need this module, ask on GitHub Issues or Discussions.
company.err_download_mismatch: The download didn't match the module you asked for, so it was not installed. Try again; if it keeps happening, ask on GitHub Issues or Discussions.
company.err_price_list_missing: There is no price list called {name}. Choose one from the list.
company.err_price_list_derived: {name} is worked out from the base price, so it can't be the base. Choose a different price list as the base.
